inao.name: INAO, Délimitation parcellaire des AOC viticoles
inao.attribution: Institut national de l'origine et de la qualité (INAO)
inao.notes: Mirror of the official file. Prefer the data.gouv.fr download when available.

eupdo.name: A geospatial inventory of regulatory information for wine protected designations of origin in Europe
eupdo.notes: Outlines follow the communes named in each product specification.

bfs.name: Generalised canton boundaries 2024
bfs.license: Open use, source must be provided

mapterhorn.name: Mapterhorn terrain tiles
mapterhorn.licence: open licences of each source DEM
mapterhorn.used_for: hillshade, 3D terrain, per place elevation, slope and aspect (read live), and the stored terrain figures of pipeline/terrain_stats.py

geoboundaries.name: geoBoundaries gbOpen, simplified administrative boundaries
geoboundaries.attribution: Runfola et al. (2020), geoBoundaries: A global database of political administrative boundaries, PLoS ONE
geoboundaries.used_for: outlines of wine places defined by administrative units (pipeline/world_specs.py)

wine_australia.name: Wine Geographical Indications Australia
wine_australia.attribution: Geographical Indications of Australia, © Wine Australia
wine_australia.notes: Copy published as CC0 by adynak/WineRegions; rings are cut at 5,000 vertices. Replace with the official FeatureServer layers when reachable.

laws.CL: Decreto 464/1994, consolidated text (LeyChile idNorma 13601), amendment Diario Oficial 2025-05-14
laws.ZA: Wine of Origin Scheme, Liquor Products Act 60 of 1989 (SAWIS)
laws.NZ: Geographical Indications (Wine and Spirits) Registration Act 2006 (IPONZ register)
laws.BR: INPI list of recognised IPs, 21 July 2026
laws.GE: Sakpatenti register of appellations of origin
laws.CA: O. Reg. 359/24 (VQA Act, Ontario); Wines of Marque Regulation (British Columbia); CARTV IGP Vin du Québec

geonames.name: GeoNames cities5000
geonames.used_for: nearest town and city of each place (pipeline/context.py); towns on the map (pipeline/geo.py)

naturalearth_physical.name: Natural Earth 1:10m coastline, rivers and lake centerlines (with the Europe and North America supplements), lakes, physical regions, elevation points
naturalearth_physical.used_for: distance to the sea, rivers and lakes nearby (pipeline/context.py); named rivers, lakes, ranges and peaks on the map and in search (pipeline/geo.py)

openfreemap.name: OpenFreeMap planet vector tiles (OpenMapTiles schema)
openfreemap.used_for: read live by the web page from zoom 9: waterways, water, lake names, peaks, villages

lwin.name: LWIN, the Liv-ex Wine Identification Number (LWIN database)
lwin.notes: Live wine records only. Each wine is placed on an atlas place by pipeline/lwin.py; names are kept as published.

chreg.name: Swiss wine areas, communal appellations and grands crus below the cantonal AOC, all cantons
chreg.license: Editorial list CC BY 4.0; commune outlines open use with attribution (BFS GEOSTAT / swisstopo); Calamin outline ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap)
chreg.attribution: Open Wine Atlas contributors, from the cantonal wine laws and vineyard statistics of every wine canton and BLW Das Weinjahr 2025; each figure carries its source in pipeline/lists/ch_regions.json

france_communes.name: French commune boundaries (IGN ADMIN EXPRESS, simplified)
france_communes.used_for: outlines of the Champagne communes and vineyard zones (pipeline/champagne.py)

bordeaux_classified.name: Official classifications of Bordeaux wines
bordeaux_classified.attribution: 1855 classification (Conseil des Grands Crus Classés en 1855), Graves 1959 (arrêté of 7 Aug 1953, revised 1959), Saint-Émilion 2022 (INAO)
bordeaux_classified.license: facts; CC BY 4.0 for the compilation
bordeaux_classified.locations: Wikipedia article coordinates (CC BY-SA) and OpenStreetMap winery points (ODbL)
